name: Positional hole: blind 8mm-radius bore, 10mm deep, into an 80x50x15 plate
notes: The blind-depth half of the hole operation's conformance pair (see hole-through-all-plate-r8.json for the through-all half, which reproduces boolean-cut-box-cylinder.json's plate+bore exactly). Geometry: plate spans x[-40,40] y[-25,25] z[0,15] (same base-center convention as create_box). The hole's placement origin sits on the plate's top face at (15,0,15) with the default drilling axis (-Z), so the tool cuts downward from z=15 to z=5 — a blind pocket that does NOT break through the bottom face. Analytic derivation: removed volume = pi*8^2*10 = 640*pi, so volume = 80*50*15 - 640*pi = 60000 - 640*pi. Surface: the top face loses a disc of area 64*pi (now open into the hole) but the hole itself adds a lateral wall of area 2*pi*8*10 = 160*pi PLUS a new flat bottom cap (the blind hole floor) of area 64*pi, so surface = 11900 - 64*pi + 160*pi + 64*pi = 11900 + 160*pi. Center of mass: the removed material is a cylinder of volume 640*pi centered at (15, 0, 10) (z-midpoint of [5,15]); comX = -15*640*pi / (60000-640*pi), comZ = (7.5*60000 - 10*640*pi) / (60000-640*pi). Topology verified against pinned OCCT V8_0_0_p1: 8 faces (6 plate faces, top carrying the hole loop, + the new blind-hole lateral wall and its flat floor cap), 15 edges (12 plate + top hole circle + floor circle + lateral seam), 10 vertices (8 plate + 2 seam endpoints) — one more face than the through-all case because the blind floor is a face the through-cut never creates.
